description: This file defines API endpoints for managing user files within a FastAPI application. It includes functions to list, upload, and delete files, with integration to Supabase storage and database for storing file metadata. The endpoints handle file validation, user authorization, and interactions with Supabase, supporting operations like listing files, uploading new files with size/type validation, and deleting files ensuring ownership and session constraints.
